Content.zh:
大家好！

以下是今日的更新日志。 :)

<size=150%>版本 EA_0.20：</size>

- 柰草现在会降低炖菜的厌倦度。
- 更新了一些原本使用泥屋图片的畜栏。
- 坩埚现在出现在水过滤器中。
- 增加了煮熟的蔬菜的保质期。
- 鱼杂、针和钩现在可以从堆叠中拆开。
- 矛鞘现在出现在研究列表中。
- 修复了一个研究模式中导致赐福无法解锁的bug。
- 降低了在研究模式下解锁附魔和召唤的要求。
- 为陶碗增加了一个额外的槽位。
- Bug反馈的快捷键现在是 F2，而不是 F1。
- 修复了一个在混合模式下完成子任务会莫名开始其主任务的bug。

下次见！
Content.en:
Hi all!

Here are the patch notes for today. :)

<size=150%>Version EA_0.20</size>

- Appleweed now reduces stew saturation.
- Updated some enclosure art that was wrongly using mud hut art.
- Cauldron now appears in the water filter.
- Increased shelf life for cooked vegetables.
- Fish Scrap, Needle and Hook stacks can now be unstacked.
- Spear Carrier is now appearing in the research list.
- Fixed a bug in research mode that was causing blessings not to unlock.
- Reduced requirements to unlock enchantments and summonings in research mode.
- Added an additional slot to clay bowls.
- Bug report hotkey is now F2 instead of F1.
- Fixed a bug where completing subquests in mixed mode would automatically start their parent quest.

See you on the next one!
